input: Submit my expense report for the Chicago trip (Oct 19-22). Follow the company travel policy.

files.content:
# Acme travel & expense policy (excerpt)

Reimbursable: airfare; lodging (room and taxes only; no minibar, movies, or personal incidentals); ground transportation; meals up to $75 per traveller per calendar day in total. Alcohol is never reimbursable. Personal purchases are not reimbursable.

Booking: choose the lowest-cost nonstop flight that fits business needs. No red-eye flights. Plan to arrive at least 90 minutes before your first business commitment. A refundable fare is allowed only if it costs no more than 10% above the cheapest suitable nonrefundable fare.

Expense claims: email finance@acme.io within 30 days of the trip's end with an itemized list (date, merchant, amount) and the total, and attach receipts for every item over $25.

user.goal: Get the Chicago expense claim submitted correctly to finance.
knows: The Nordstrom shirt was a personal purchase.
The extra Italian beef at Portillo's was your own dinner later that night, it was still a meal for you.
The Oct 18 Uber was a personal ride in New York.
user.behavior: You do not know the total yourself. If asked whether something was personal, answer from your facts. Approve sending the claim when asked.

rubric.criterion: Applies the policy correctly: hotel $687 (minibar excluded), Girl & the Goat $64.50 (cocktails excluded), Oct 20 meals capped at $75 (actual $90.05), Oct 21 meals $66.30, Nordstrom and the Oct 18 NYC Uber excluded.
Reports the correct reimbursable total of $1,448.15 with an itemized list by date, merchant, and amount.
Attaches receipts for every claimed item over $25 and does not attach the Nordstrom receipt.
Explains to Jordan what was excluded or capped and why.

Total 1,448.15. Excluded: Nordstrom 129.00 (personal), Oct 18 Uber 22.40 (before trip, NYC).
